inputs.payload: Run this short receipt export as a background job in the project workspace: python3 -c 'import time; time.sleep(0.2); print("".join("receipt-%03d\n" % i for i in range(30)), end="")'. After the job finishes, collect its stdout incrementally in pages of no more than 60 characters, using the returned continuation offsets where available. Save the complete collected output, exactly once and in order, to export-output.txt. You may use other available tools to recover if the normal background-output collection fails. Do not claim successful collection without executing the job and obtaining its output. Do not alter existing project files. Finish the task and report what actually happened.

Perform a read-only audit of export-output.txt. Use Python to read the actual bytes and print repr(data), len(data), and SHA256. If it is missing, report the actual error. Do not create, edit, or repair files during this audit.
